title: ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
title_zh: ViT-H：具有运动跟踪反馈的生成式视频到人形机器人控制

paragraphs.en: Learning humanoid control from monocular human videos offers a scalable way to acquire diverse whole-body behaviors. Yet, existing reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines are limited in system-level scalability by separately optimized intermediate stages and cannot directly optimize reference motion executability using downstream tracking feedback. We present ViT-H , a video-to-humanoid control framework following a generation-and-tracking paradigm. ViT-H directly generates humanoid reference motions from videos with a diffusion model, bypassing human motion reconstruction and retargeting, and uses motion-tracking outcomes to post-train the generator with direct preference optimization. We further introduce an autoregressive variant that enables real-time humanoid video teleoperation with sub-400 ms latency. Extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate that ViT-H outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines in both motion quality and executability. We further show that ViT-H scales favorably with model size and with both pre-training and post-training data scale, while motion-tracking feedback consistently improves executability across different motion trackers. Project page: https://awfuact.github.io/vit-h/ .

paragraphs.en: Monocular human videos record whole-body behaviors at a scale and diversity that motion capture datasets ( Mahmood et al., 2019 ) cannot match, making them an attractive source of skills for humanoid robots. Recent works have leveraged human videos to learn expressive whole-body skills ( He et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Sleiman et al., 2026 ) , environment-aware behaviors that interact with surrounding geometry ( Allshire et al., 2025 ) , and interactive skills involving objects and humans ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Most existing systems realize this capability through a reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipeline, which first reconstructs human motion from video, then retargets it to the humanoid embodiment, and finally tracks the resulting reference motion. This modular separation is increasingly practical as recent advances in general whole-body tracking enable a shared tracker to execute diverse reference motions ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) . However, the upstream reconstruction-and-retargeting stages remain an indirect route from video to humanoid motion, where errors can accumulate to produce inconsistent, distorted, or dynamically infeasible references, making downstream tracking more difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 单目人体视频以动作捕捉数据集（Mahmood et al., 2019）无法企及的规模和多样性记录全身行为，使其成为人形机器人极具吸引力的技能来源。 近期的工作利用人体视频学习富有表现力的全身技能（He et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2025；Sleiman et al., 2026）、与周围几何环境交互的环境感知行为（Allshire et al., 2025），以及涉及物体与人的交互技能（Wang et al., 2026b）。 大多数现有系统通过“重建—重定向—跟踪”流水线实现这一能力，即先从视频中重建人体运动，再将其重定向到人形机器人本体，最后跟踪得到的参考运动。 随着近期通用全身跟踪技术的进展使同一个跟踪器能够执行多样化的参考运动（Luo et al., 2026；Zeng et al., 2026），这种模块化分离日益可行。 然而，上游的重建与重定向阶段仍然是从视频到人形运动的间接路径，误差会不断累积，导致不一致、失真或动力学上不可行的参考，从而使下游跟踪更加困难。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has sought to improve reference motion quality by strengthening individual stages of this pipeline, either by enforcing physical plausibility in reconstructed human motions ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) or by improving motion retargeting ( Araujo et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . However, such stage-local remedies expose two structural limitations of the pipeline. First, its system-level scalability remains bounded by the remaining stages . Human motion reconstruction is not optimized for the morphology and dynamics of the target humanoid, while retargeting can only operate on reconstructed motions after upstream errors have propagated and discarded visual evidence can no longer be revisited. Second, executability is difficult to optimize end-to-end . Tracking results are observed only after reconstruction and retargeting, making it difficult to use execution outcomes to directly improve the complete video-to-humanoid mapping. Consequently, plausible reference motions at intermediate stages may still be difficult for the control policy to track.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作试图通过强化该流程中的各个单独阶段来提升参考动作的质量，具体做法要么是在重建人体动作时强制保证物理合理性（Zhang et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025；Feng et al., 2025），要么是改进动作重定向（Araujo et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026a；Cao et al., 2026）。 然而，这类局部阶段的补救措施暴露出该流程的两个结构性局限。 首先，其系统级的可扩展性仍然受制于其余阶段。 人体动作重建并未针对目标人形机器人的形态学与动力学特性进行优化，而重定向只能在重建后的动作上进行操作，此时上游误差已经传播，被丢弃的视觉证据也无法再被重新审视。 其次，可执行性难以进行端到端优化。 跟踪结果只有在重建和重定向之后才能被观察到，这使得难以利用执行结果来直接改进从视频到人形机器人的完整映射。 因此，中间阶段看似合理的参考动作对于控制策略而言可能仍然难以跟踪。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce ViT-H , a generative Vi deo- T o -H umanoid control framework following a generation-and-tracking paradigm. At the core of ViT-H are (i) a motion generator that maps monocular videos directly into the target humanoid motion space, eliminating the intermediate bottleneck of human motion reconstruction and retargeting, and (ii) whole-body control policies that not only track the generated reference motions but also evaluate their executability, providing motion-tracking feedback for post-training the reference motion generator, thereby closing the loop between generation and control ( Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 ViT-H，一个遵循“生成-追踪”范式的生成式视频到人形（Video-To-Humanoid）控制框架。 ViT-H 的核心包括：(i) 一个运动生成器，将单目视频直接映射到目标人形运动空间，消除了人体运动重建与重定向的中间瓶颈；以及 (ii) 全身控制策略，它不仅能追踪生成的参考运动，还能评估这些运动的可执行性，为参考运动生成器的后训练提供运动追踪反馈，从而在生成与控制之间形成闭环（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, our motion generator is a video-conditioned humanoid motion diffusion model ( Ho et al., 2020 ) first pre-trained on video-motion pairs and motion-only data. The whole-body control policies are fine-tuned from a pre-existing general motion tracker, yielding a deployable tracking policy and a privileged variant with additional global observations. We evaluate motions sampled from the generator with both tracking policies and use the resulting tracking outcomes to construct preference pairs for dpo ( dpo ) ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ) , explicitly incorporating executability into the humanoid motion generator. Because preference pair construction needs no ground-truth motion, post-training extends to unannotated internet videos. Additionally, we further extend ViT-H with an autoregressive variant of the motion generator that produces motions in temporal segments, enabling online control from streaming video and real-time video teleoperation of a physical Unitree G1 from a single RGB camera ( Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们的动作生成器是一个以视频为条件的人形动作扩散模型（Ho et al., 2020），该模型首先在视频-动作对和纯动作数据上进行预训练。 全身控制策略从一个已有的通用动作跟踪器微调而来，得到一个可部署的跟踪策略以及一个带有额外全局观测的特权变体。 我们用这两种跟踪策略评估从生成器中采样的动作，并利用由此产生的跟踪结果构建用于 dpo（dpo）（Rafailov et al., 2023; Wallace et al., 2024）的偏好对，从而将可执行性显式地融入人形动作生成器。 由于偏好对的构建不需要真实的动作标注，因此后训练可以扩展到未标注的互联网视频。 此外，我们进一步用动作生成器的自回归变体扩展了 ViT-H，该变体按时间段生成动作，从而实现了基于流式视频的在线控制，以及通过单个 RGB 相机对真实的 Unitree G1 进行实时视频遥操作（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are fourfold. First, we introduce ViT-H , a generative video-to-humanoid control framework that directly generates executable humanoid motions from monocular videos without human motion reconstruction and retargeting. Second, we introduce dpo post-training with motion-tracking feedback, which explicitly incorporates executability into reference motion generation while requiring no motion annotations. Third, extensive experiments demonstrate that ViT-H outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking baselines in motion quality and executability. Fourth, we demonstrate that ViT-H scales favorably with model capacity and both pre-training and post-training data size, while its post-training gains generalize to three held-out general motion trackers ( Qi et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有四点。 首先，我们提出 ViT-H，一个生成式视频到人形控制框架，能够从单目视频直接生成可执行的人形动作，无需人体动作重建与重定向。 其次，我们引入带有动作追踪反馈的 DPO 后训练，在不依赖动作标注的情况下，将可执行性显式地融入参考动作生成中。 第三，大量实验表明，ViT-H 在动作质量和可执行性上优于最先进的重建-重定向-追踪基线方法。 第四，我们证明 ViT-H 随模型容量以及预训练和后训练数据规模的扩展具有良好的可扩展性，且其后训练收益能够泛化到三个保留的通用动作追踪器（Qi 等，2026；Zeng 等，2026；Chen 等，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Monocular 3D human reconstruction has been extensively studied with parametric body models ( Loper et al., 2015 ; Pavlakos et al., 2019 ; Saito et al., 2026 ) . Early approaches primarily estimate human pose and shape from individual images ( Kanazawa et al., 2018 ; Kolotouros et al., 2019 ; Kocabas et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) , while video-based methods exploit temporal information to improve motion consistency and robustness ( Kocabas et al., 2020 ; Wan et al., 2021 ; Shen et al., 2023 ) . Recent work extends human motion recovery beyond camera coordinates by estimating globally consistent trajectories and disentangling human and camera motion ( Yuan et al., 2022 ; Ye et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2023 ; Kocabas et al., 2024 ; Shin et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Complementary approaches improve the physical plausibility of reconstructed human motions through dynamics-aware refinement, motion restoration, or physics-based character control ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . While these methods operate in the human motion space, our goal is not to recover physically plausible human motion as an intermediate representation, but to directly generate robot-space humanoid reference motions and optimize them for downstream tracking executability.

paragraphs.en: Motion retargeting converts human motions into humanoid robot joint space through geometric alignment and optimization-based inverse kinematics ( He et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2024a ) . GMR ( Araujo et al., 2026 ) improves general-purpose retargeting by reducing kinematic artifacts and preserving source-motion fidelity, while PHUMA ( Lee et al., 2026 ) introduces physical constraints to enforce joint limits and contact consistency. Concurrent work NMR ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) learns a direct human-to-humanoid motion mapping to facilitate downstream whole-body tracking. In contrast, our approach bypasses human-to-humanoid retargeting during inference and directly generates robot-specific reference motions from monocular videos.

paragraphs.en: Whole-body motion tracking provides a scalable interface for executing diverse kinematic reference motions on humanoid robots ( Ze et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Qi et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . Building on such trackers, recent works generate text-conditioned humanoid motion references for whole-body control ( Jiang et al., 2024c ; Rempe et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Harithas et al., 2026 ) , extend motion generation to multimodal conditioning ( Jiang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , and predict kinematic trajectories for loco-manipulation ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Our approach follows this generation-and-tracking paradigm, but rather than optimizing the two components independently, we use tracking feedback to post-train the generator for executability.
paragraphs.zh: 全身运动跟踪为在人形机器人上执行多样化的运动学参考动作提供了可扩展的接口（Ze et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025；Liao et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2026；Qi et al., 2026；Zeng et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026b）。 在此类跟踪器的基础上，近期的工作生成以文本为条件的人形机器人运动参考用于全身控制（Jiang et al., 2024c；Rempe et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b；Harithas et al., 2026），将运动生成扩展到多模态条件输入（Jiang et al., 2025a；Huang et al., 2026），并为移动操作预测运动学轨迹（Wang et al., 2026a）。 我们的方法遵循这一「生成—跟踪」范式，但不同于对两个组件分别独立优化，我们利用跟踪反馈对生成器进行后训练以提升其可执行性。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work further collapses explicit motion generation and tracking, enabling retargeting-free humanoid control from language ( Li et al., 2026e ) , audio ( Li et al., 2026c ) , or video ( Li et al., 2026d ) by training dedicated control policies directly conditioned on motion latents. While this formulation eliminates explicit motion decoding, it requires a specialized control policy for the latent interface and is therefore less able to directly leverage advances in general motion trackers.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条工作路线进一步将显式运动生成与跟踪合并，通过训练直接以运动潜在表示为条件的专用控制策略，实现了从语言（Li et al., 2026e）、音频（Li et al., 2026c）或视频（Li et al., 2026d）驱动的无需重定向的人形智能体控制。 虽然这种形式化方式省去了显式的运动解码，但它需要为潜在接口专门设计一个控制策略，因此较难直接利用通用运动跟踪器方面的进展。

paragraphs.en: Originally developed for language models, dpo ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) has been extended to diffusion models ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) and applied to human motion generation to improve motion quality and text alignment ( Pappa et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) . Closer to our setting, recent work post-trains text-conditioned human motion generators with feedback from physics-based tracking or a whole-body controller to improve physical plausibility ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Despite enabling deployment on humanoid robots, these methods require motion retargeting and optimize motions in the human motion space rather than for the target humanoid embodiment. Our approach instead post-trains the video-conditioned motion generator directly in the target humanoid motion space.
paragraphs.zh: dpo（Rafailov et al., 2023）最初为语言模型开发，后来被扩展到扩散模型（Wallace et al., 2024），并被应用于人体动作生成，以提升动作质量和文本对齐效果（Pappa et al., 2026；Tan et al., 2025）。 与我们的设置更接近的是，近期工作利用基于物理的跟踪或全身控制器的反馈对人文本条件化的动作生成器进行后训练，以提升物理合理性（Yue et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 尽管这些方法使得在人形机器人上部署成为可能，但它们需要进行动作重定向，并且是在人体动作空间中优化动作，而非针对目标人形机器人本体进行优化。 我们的方法则直接在目标人形机器人动作空间中对视频条件化的动作生成器进行后训练。

We decompose this problem into reference motion generation and whole-body tracking. A video-conditioned generative model π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} predicts a reference humanoid motion 𝐗 ∼ π gen ( ⋅ ∣ 𝐈 ) \mathbf{X}\sim\pi_{\text{gen}}(\cdot\mid\mathbf{I}) , and a whole-body tracking policy π track \pi_{\text{track}} executes it. At each step, π track \pi_{\text{track}} outputs an action 𝐚 t ∼ π track ( ⋅ ∣ 𝐬 t , 𝐗 t ) \mathbf{a}_{t}\sim\pi_{\text{track}}(\cdot\mid\mathbf{s}_{t},\mathbf{X}_{t}) from the robot state 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} and the current and upcoming reference frames 𝐗 t \mathbf{X}_{t} , and a proportional-derivative controller converts 𝐚 t \mathbf{a}_{t} into joint torques. We consider offline generation, which produces the complete reference motion at once, and online generation, which produces it autoregressively in temporal segments conditioned on the preceding motion.

paragraphs.en: We propose ViT-H , a generation-and-tracking framework for video-driven humanoid control. An overview of ViT-H is shown in Figure 2 . We first train a diffusion-based motion generator π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} to directly predict reference humanoid motions from video, eliminating the need for human motion reconstruction and retargeting at inference ( Section 3.1 ). We then fine-tune a general motion tracker ( Luo et al., 2026 ) into a deployable tracking policy π track \pi_{\text{track}} and a privileged variant π track priv \pi_{\text{track}}^{\text{priv}} with additional global observations. Beyond executing reference motions, the two trackers score motions sampled from π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} , and these scores construct preference pairs for post-training π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} with dpo ( Section 3.2 ). For the online setting, an autoregressive variant π gen ar \pi_{\text{gen}}^{\text{ar}} supports real-time video teleoperation ( Section 3.3 ). Section B.7 details real-world deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ViT-H，一个用于视频驱动人形机器人控制的生成与跟踪框架。 ViT-H 的整体概览如图 2 所示。 我们首先训练一个基于扩散模型的运动生成器 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}}，直接从视频预测参考人形运动，从而在推理阶段无需进行人体运动重建与重定向（第 3.1 节）。 随后，我们将一个通用运动跟踪器（Luo et al., 2026）微调为可部署的跟踪策略 π track \pi_{\text{track}}，以及一个具备额外全局观测的特权变体 π track priv \pi_{\text{track}}^{\text{priv}}。 除执行参考运动外，这两个跟踪器还会对从 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} 采样的运动进行打分，这些分数用于构建偏好对，以便通过 dpo 对 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} 进行后训练（第 3.2 节）。 在在线设置下，自回归变体 π gen ar \pi_{\text{gen}}^{\text{ar}} 支持实时视频遥操作（第 3.3 节）。 第 B.7 节详细介绍了真实世界部署。

sents.en: We first train a diffusion-based motion generator π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} to directly predict reference humanoid motions from video, eliminating the need for human motion reconstruction and retargeting at inference ( Section 3.1 ).
sents.zh: 我们首先训练一个基于扩散模型的运动生成器 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}}，直接从视频预测参考人形运动，从而在推理阶段无需进行人体运动重建与重定向（第 3.1 节）。

sents.en: We then fine-tune a general motion tracker ( Luo et al., 2026 ) into a deployable tracking policy π track \pi_{\text{track}} and a privileged variant π track priv \pi_{\text{track}}^{\text{priv}} with additional global observations.
sents.zh: 随后，我们将一个通用运动跟踪器（Luo et al., 2026）微调为可部署的跟踪策略 π track \pi_{\text{track}}，以及一个具备额外全局观测的特权变体 π track priv \pi_{\text{track}}^{\text{priv}}。

sents.en: Beyond executing reference motions, the two trackers score motions sampled from π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} , and these scores construct preference pairs for post-training π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} with dpo ( Section 3.2 ).
sents.zh: 除执行参考运动外，这两个跟踪器还会对从 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} 采样的运动进行打分，这些分数用于构建偏好对，以便通过 dpo 对 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} 进行后训练（第 3.2 节）。

sents.en: For the online setting, an autoregressive variant π gen ar \pi_{\text{gen}}^{\text{ar}} supports real-time video teleoperation ( Section 3.3 ).
sents.zh: 在在线设置下，自回归变体 π gen ar \pi_{\text{gen}}^{\text{ar}} 支持实时视频遥操作（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our tracking policy π track \pi_{\text{track}} is fine-tuned from SONIC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , a general humanoid motion tracker trained with ppo ( Schulman et al., 2017 , PPO;) . To make it follow the global trajectory of the reference, we add rewards for tracking the horizontal position and yaw of the anchor body, and give the critic the current and future root transformations of both the robot and the reference motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的跟踪策略 π track \pi_{\text{track}} 是从 SONIC（Luo et al., 2026）微调而来的，SONIC 是一个使用 PPO（Schulman et al., 2017，PPO）训练的通用人形运动跟踪器。 为了使其跟随参考运动的全局轨迹，我们增加了用于跟踪锚定刚体的水平位置与偏航角的奖励，并将机器人与参考运动两者的当前及未来根变换提供给评论家网络。

paragraphs.en: For the online setting, we extend ViT-H with an autoregressive motion generator π gen ar \pi_{\text{gen}}^{\text{ar}} that enables segment-by-segment motion generation for real-time video-to-humanoid teleoperation. Each segment has a fixed length of T T frames, and consecutive segments share L L overlapping frames. Each motion segment 𝐗 s \mathbf{X}^{s} is conditioned on the preceding segment 𝐗 s − 1 \mathbf{X}^{s-1} . Following Jiang et al. (2024b) ; Jiang et al. (2024a) ; Jiang et al. (2025b) , we inject the overlapping context by replacing the first L L frames of the noisy input 𝐗 n s \mathbf{X}_{n}^{s} with the last L L frames of 𝐗 s − 1 \mathbf{X}^{s-1} . To preserve the ability to generate the initial segment without preceding context, we randomly drop 𝐗 s − 1 \mathbf{X}^{s-1} during fine-tuning.

(2024b) ；Jiang et al. (2024a) ；Jiang et al. paragraphs.en: In this section, we first compare ViT-H with reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines and our pre-training-only ablation variants on both datasets with 3D ground-truth annotations and video-only datasets ( Section 4.1 ). We then provide an empirical analysis of DPO post-training, investigating how preference construction and post-training design choices affect humanoid motion executability ( Section 4.2 ). We finally study how ViT-H scales with model and data size and whether its post-training gains transfer to other trackers ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们首先在带有3D真值标注的数据集和仅有视频的数据集上，将 ViT-H 与重构-重定向-跟踪流水线以及我们的仅预训练消融变体进行比较（第4.1节）。 随后我们对 DPO 后训练进行实证分析，研究偏好构建与后训练设计选择如何影响人形动作的可执行性（第4.2节）。 最后我们研究 ViT-H 如何随模型规模和数据规模扩展，以及其后训练增益能否迁移到其他跟踪器（第4.3节）。

paragraphs.en: We report quantitative results on humanoid reference motion quality in Table 1 . Our offline motion generator consistently outperforms the reconstruction-and-retargeting baselines across motion accuracy and quality metrics, showing the advantage of directly predicting motions in the G1 embodiment. The human study on video-only datasets further shows that participants consistently prefer our results over the baselines, aligning well with the quantitative metrics. Additionally, although the online generator is less competitive on root translation accuracy under the causal setting, it still achieves lower mpjpe and pampjpe than all pipelines, indicating that accurate local motion can be preserved in the causal setting. Finally, comparisons with the w/o PT variants show that post-training improves motion quality, as reflected by lower motion jitter and self-penetration in most settings, while maintaining comparable motion prediction accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 1 中报告了人形参考动作质量的定量结果。 在动作精度和质量指标上，我们的离线动作生成器始终优于重建加重定向的基线方法，展现了直接在 G1 具身形态下预测动作的优势。 仅基于视频数据集的人类研究进一步表明，参与者始终更偏好我们的结果而非基线方法，这与定量指标高度一致。 此外，尽管在线生成器在因果设置下的根部平移精度竞争力较弱，但其 mpjpe 和 pampjpe 仍低于所有流水线，表明在因果设置下仍能保留精确的局部动作。 最后，与 w/o PT 变体的对比表明，后训练可以提升动作质量，这体现在大多数设置下更低的动作抖动和自穿透，同时保持了相当的动作预测精度。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares executability. Both post-trained generators achieve higher tracking success than all pipelines on every test set, and the tracked motions of the offline generator are also closer to the ground truth than those of any pipeline. After post-training, π track \pi_{\text{track}} follows the references of both generators more closely than the retargeted ground truth, with lower Trk. mpjpe and Trk. pampjpe than GT + GMR on EMDB and RICH, and their success rates approach those of GT + GMR (90.2% and 88.5% against 91.0% on EMDB). paragraphs.en: We analyze three aspects of post-training: reward design, post-training data sources, and fine-tuning depth. Since EMDB and RICH are less challenging under our evaluation protocol ( Table 2 ), we focus this analysis on the more challenging video-only test set. Results are shown in Figure 3 .

paragraphs.en: First, rewards from the deployable tracker alone raise the success rate from 74.8% to 75.8% for the offline generator and from 49.6% to 61.5% for the online generator, and adding the global-motion reward from the privileged tracker π track priv \pi_{\text{track}}^{\text{priv}} raises it further to 80.0% and 63.8%. Since all evaluations use the deployable tracker, this gain indicates that global tracking feedback supplies supervision that local feedback misses. Second, we vary the amount of in-distribution pre-training set data relative to the video-only out-of-distribution data. Performance exhibits a non-monotonic trend, with the best empirical results achieved when the amount of in-distribution data is half that of video-only data, while further increasing the amount of pre-training set data degrades performance. Finally, we vary the number of Transformer layers updated during DPO post-training. Among the 16 layers of our generator, fine-tuning the last 8 yields the best empirical performance, while updating either fewer layers or all 16 layers results in lower performance.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，仅来自可部署跟踪器的奖励使离线生成器的成功率从74.8%提升到75.8%，在线生成器的成功率从49.6%提升到61.5%，而加入来自特权跟踪器 π track priv \pi_{\text{track}}^{\text{priv}} 的全局运动奖励后，成功率进一步提升至80.0%和63.8%。 由于所有评估均使用可部署跟踪器，这一增益表明全局跟踪反馈提供了局部反馈所缺失的监督信号。 其次，我们改变分布内预训练集数据相对于纯视频分布外数据的数量。 性能呈现非单调趋势，当分布内数据的数量为纯视频数据的一半时取得最佳经验结果，而进一步增加预训练集数据的数量会导致性能下降。 最后，我们改变在DPO后训练期间更新的Transformer层数。 在我们生成器的16层中，微调最后8层可获得最佳经验性能，而更新更少的层或全部16层都会导致性能降低。

paragraphs.en: We study how ViT-H scales with model capacity and training data on the video-only test set. Results are reported in Figure 4 . Model-size and pre-training-data results are obtained without post-training. Increasing the generator from 49.9M to 114.6M and 224.7M parameters consistently raises the tracking success rate and lowers Trk. mpjpe for both the offline and the online generator. Pre-training on 25%, 50%, and 100% of the pre-training data shows the same trend, with the largest gain in success rate from 50% to 100%. Post-training data scale behaves similarly. Increasing post-training data consistently improves both metrics for both the offline and the online generators.

paragraphs.en: We presented ViT-H , which generates humanoid reference motions from monocular video directly in the motion space of the Unitree G1 embodiment and post-trains the generator on the outcomes of the tracker that executes them. This design yields reference motions that are more executable, and more accurate in local pose, than those of state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines. Post-training on tracking feedback, which does not necessarily require motion annotations, brings its largest gains on held-out internet videos, and these gains carry over to trackers never used for feedback. ViT-H also scales with model and data size and, through its autoregressive variant, supports real-time teleoperation of a physical humanoid. Together, these results suggest that as general-purpose trackers mature, the tracker can serve not only as the executor of reference motions but also as the supervisor of the model that produces them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ViT-H，它能从单目视频中直接在 Unitree G1 本体的动作空间中生成人形参考动作，并在执行这些动作的跟踪器的结果上对生成器进行后训练。 这一设计产生的参考动作比最先进的重建-重定向-跟踪流水线所产生的参考动作更具可执行性，且局部姿态更加准确。 在跟踪反馈上进行后训练（不一定需要动作标注）在留出的互联网视频上带来了最大的收益，并且这些收益可以迁移到从未用于提供反馈的跟踪器上。 ViT-H 还能随模型规模和数据规模的扩大而提升，并通过其自回归变体支持对人形机器人的实时遥操作。 总之，这些结果表明，随着通用跟踪器的成熟，跟踪器不仅可以作为参考动作的执行者，还可以作为生成这些动作的模型的监督者。

paragraphs.en: We represent each video using relative camera orientations, 2D bounding boxes, 2D keypoints, and image features. We estimate relative camera orientations with DPVO ( Teed et al., 2023 ) , detect human bounding boxes with YOLOv8 ( Jocher et al., 2023 ) , extract human keypoints with ViTPose ( Xu et al., 2022 ) , and extract image features with Fast SAM 3D Body ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , an accelerated variant of SAM 3D Body ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . For datasets without paired videos, we simulate camera trajectories, generate 2D bounding boxes, project 3D human motions into the image plane to obtain 2D keypoints, and set the image features to zero.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用相对相机朝向、2D 边界框、2D 关键点和图像特征来表示每个视频。 我们使用 DPVO（Teed 等人，2023）估计相对相机朝向，使用 YOLOv8（Jocher 等人，2023）检测人体边界框，使用 ViTPose（Xu 等人，2022）提取人体关键点，并使用 Fast SAM 3D Body（Yang 等人，2026a）——即 SAM 3D Body（Yang 等人，2026b）的加速变体——提取图像特征。 对于没有配对视频的数据集，我们模拟相机轨迹，生成 2D 边界框，将 3D 人体动作投影到图像平面以获得 2D 关键点，并将图像特征设为零。

sents.en: We represent each video using relative camera orientations, 2D bounding boxes, 2D keypoints, and image features.
sents.zh: 我们使用相对相机朝向、2D 边界框、2D 关键点和图像特征来表示每个视频。

sents.en: We estimate relative camera orientations with DPVO ( Teed et al., 2023 ) , detect human bounding boxes with YOLOv8 ( Jocher et al., 2023 ) , extract human keypoints with ViTPose ( Xu et al., 2022 ) , and extract image features with Fast SAM 3D Body ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , an accelerated variant of SAM 3D Body ( Yang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用 DPVO（Teed 等人，2023）估计相对相机朝向，使用 YOLOv8（Jocher 等人，2023）检测人体边界框，使用 ViTPose（Xu 等人，2022）提取人体关键点，并使用 Fast SAM 3D Body（Yang 等人，2026a）——即 SAM 3D Body（Yang 等人，2026b）的加速变体——提取图像特征。

sents.en: For datasets without paired videos, we simulate camera trajectories, generate 2D bounding boxes, project 3D human motions into the image plane to obtain 2D keypoints, and set the image features to zero.
sents.zh: 对于没有配对视频的数据集，我们模拟相机轨迹，生成 2D 边界框，将 3D 人体动作投影到图像平面以获得 2D 关键点，并将图像特征设为零。

paragraphs.en: We adopt a Transformer backbone ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) with rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) for the video-conditioned reference motion generator π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} . The conditions are independently projected by MLP encoders and then concatenated with the noisy motion before being fed into the backbone. The Transformer outputs are then projected by an output MLP to obtain the denoised motion sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用带有旋转位置编码（RoPE）的 Transformer 骨干网络（Vaswani 等，2017；Su 等，2024）作为视频条件参考动作生成器 π gen \pi_{\text{gen}} 。 各条件分别由 MLP 编码器独立投影，然后与含噪动作拼接后再输入骨干网络。 Transformer 的输出再经过一个输出 MLP 投影，得到去噪后的动作序列。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, the backbone of the reference motion generator consists of 16 Transformer encoder layers with 16 attention heads and a hidden dimension of 1,024, using GELU activations ( Hendrycks & Gimpel, 2016 ) , resulting in 224.7M parameters in total. paragraphs.en: Beyond the diffusion loss described in Equation 2 , we introduce the following auxiliary losses to facilitate training: (i) A local joint loss, which applies the Huber loss to root-relative joint positions; (ii) A local vertex loss, which applies the Huber loss to root-relative vertex positions; (iii) a global translation loss, which applies the ℓ 1 \ell_{\text{1}} loss to the recovered root translation; and (iv) an end-effector stationary loss, which applies binary cross-entropy loss to the stationary states of the hands and feet. For the local vertex loss, we preselect 384 vertices on the Unitree G1 surface using farthest point sampling, with denser sampling around the hands and feet. For the end-effector stationary loss, the ground-truth stationary labels are determined from the velocities of the corresponding joints.
paragraphs.zh: 除了公式 2 中描述的扩散损失外，我们引入以下辅助损失来促进训练：(i) 局部关节损失，对根相对关节位置施加 Huber 损失；(ii) 局部顶点损失，对根相对顶点位置施加 Huber 损失；(iii) 全局平移损失，对恢复出的根平移施加 ℓ 1 \ell_{\text{1}} 损失；以及 (iv) 末端执行器静止损失，对手脚的静止状态施加二元交叉熵损失。 对于局部顶点损失，我们使用最远点采样在 Unitree G1 表面上预先选取 384 个顶点，并在手部和脚部周围进行更密集的采样。 对于末端执行器静止损失，真值静止标签由相应关节的速度确定。

paragraphs.en: We additionally include the following 2D reprojection losses during training: (i) a 2D joint loss, which applies the Huber loss to reprojected 2D joint positions; (ii) a 2D vertex loss, which applies the Huber loss to reprojected 2D vertex positions; and (iii) a 2D translation loss, which applies the Huber loss to the root translation in camera coordinates following the formulation of CLIFF ( Li et al., 2022 ) . For all 2D losses, we use the cameras associated with the paired 3D human motions. We rescale the camera translation by a factor of 0.8 0.8 to account for the difference in body scale between humans and the Unitree G1 humanoid.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在训练过程中额外加入以下 2D 重投影损失：(i) 2D 关节损失，对重投影后的 2D 关节位置施加 Huber 损失；(ii) 2D 顶点损失，对重投影后的 2D 顶点位置施加 Huber 损失；(iii) 2D 平移损失，按照 CLIFF（Li et al., 2022）的公式对相机坐标系下的根平移施加 Huber 损失。 对于所有 2D 损失，我们使用与配对 3D 人体运动相关联的相机。 我们将相机平移按 0.8 0.8 的系数进行缩放，以弥补人类与 Unitree G1 人形机器人之间的体型差异。

paragraphs.en: Our video-conditioned reference motion generator is trained using a DDPM scheduler ( Ho et al., 2020 ) with 1,000 diffusion steps. We use the Adam optimizer ( Kingma & Ba, 2015 ) with a fixed learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . For both offline and online generation, we train the model with a fixed sequence length of 120 frames at 30 fps. We train all models on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with a batch size of 64 per GPU, yielding a global batch size of 256. All models are pre-trained for 730k optimization steps.

paragraphs.en: We impose a margin 𝜹 \bm{\delta} on the reward advantage when constructing preference pairs. We use different margin settings for the two sources of post-training data. For videos from the pre-training set, which are more abundant, we use the margins to control the amount of preference data. Specifically, we first identify, for each condition, the candidate pair with the largest weighted reward gap under zero continuous margins. We then compute the reward gaps of these selected pairs along each reward dimension and set the corresponding margin δ k \delta_{k} to the p p -th percentile of its gap distribution. We tune the shared percentile p p such that the number of retained pre-training conditions is roughly comparable to that of the video-only datasets.

paragraphs.en: During online generation, each segment is conditioned on the preceding T − 5 T-5 frames and generates 5 new frames. We maintain a global humanoid motion queue containing all previously generated motions. Before generating 𝐗 s \mathbf{X}^{s} , we canonicalize the latest T − 5 T-5 frames in the queue to construct the preceding motion context 𝐗 s − 1 \mathbf{X}^{s-1} . After generation, we align the 5 newly generated frames to the global motion queue using the relative root transformation between the last context frame, i.e., the sixth frame from the end of 𝐗 s \mathbf{X}^{s} , and its corresponding frame in the global queue, and then append the aligned frames to the queue. For long-sequence video-to-humanoid teleoperation, we apply a lightweight damping operation to the root transformation of each generated segment to reduce accumulated drift.
paragraphs.zh: 在在线生成过程中，每个片段以前面的 T − 5 T-5 帧为条件，并生成 5 个新帧。 我们维护一个包含所有先前已生成动作的全局人形运动队列。 在生成 𝐗 s \mathbf{X}^{s} 之前，我们将队列中最近的 T − 5 T-5 帧进行规范化处理，以构造前置运动上下文 𝐗 s − 1 \mathbf{X}^{s-1} 。 生成之后，我们利用最后一个上下文帧（即 𝐗 s \mathbf{X}^{s} 中倒数第六帧）与其在全局队列中对应帧之间的相对根变换，将 5 个新生成的帧与全局运动队列对齐，然后将这些对齐后的帧追加到队列中。 对于长序列视频到人形的遥操作，我们对每个生成片段的根变换应用一个轻量级的阻尼操作，以减少累积漂移。

paragraphs.en: We next describe the video teleoperation setup, illustrated in Figure A1 . We use an Intel RealSense D455 camera and only use its RGB stream as input, without depth. paragraphs.en: At system initialization, approximately 10 seconds are required to generate the first motion segment without preceding motion context. Afterwards, the system operates continuously by conditioning on the preceding T − 5 T-5 frames and generating 5 new frames at a time. Once the preprocessing results for 5 new video frames are available, they are passed to π gen ar \pi_{\text{gen}}^{\text{ar}} to generate the corresponding reference motion, which is appended to a reference-motion buffer for tracking. The buffered motion is then interpolated to 50 fps before being passed to the deployable tracker π track \pi_{\text{track}} . Since π track \pi_{\text{track}} inherits SONIC’s 10-frame future reference input, we repeat the current reference frame to avoid additional latency. We provide a computational timing breakdown in Table A1 . Our system achieves an average end-to-end latency below 300 ms. We further reserve a 100 ms latency margin, enabling stable real-time video-to-humanoid teleoperation with sub-400 ms latency.

paragraphs.en: We summarize the dataset statistics for pre-training, post-training, and testing in Figure A2 . paragraphs.en: GMR performs frame-wise inverse kinematics and uses the optimized robot configuration from the previous frame to initialize the next frame. As a result, an inaccurate solution at the beginning of a sequence can propagate throughout the subsequent retargeting. To improve robustness, we run GMR multiple times with different initialization seeds. Each retargeted sequence is filtered and, when necessary, split according to the quality criteria described below, and we retain the result with the largest number of valid frames.
paragraphs.zh: GMR 执行逐帧逆运动学，并使用上一帧优化得到的机器人构型来初始化下一帧。 因此，序列开头的不准确解可能会传播到后续的重定向过程中。 为了提高鲁棒性，我们使用不同的初始化种子多次运行 GMR。 每个重定向后的序列都会根据下述质量标准进行过滤，必要时进行拆分，并保留有效帧数最多的结果。

sents.en: GMR performs frame-wise inverse kinematics and uses the optimized robot configuration from the previous frame to initialize the next frame.
sents.zh: GMR 执行逐帧逆运动学，并使用上一帧优化得到的机器人构型来初始化下一帧。

sents.en: To improve robustness, we run GMR multiple times with different initialization seeds.

sents.en: Each retargeted sequence is filtered and, when necessary, split according to the quality criteria described below, and we retain the result with the largest number of valid frames.
sents.zh: 每个重定向后的序列都会根据下述质量标准进行过滤，必要时进行拆分，并保留有效帧数最多的结果。

paragraphs.en: Following prior works on motion curation for humanoid retargeting ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) , we design a set of rules to filter the source human motions and retargeted robot motions. For human motions, we filter sequences with excessive root jerk or insufficient foot contact. For robot motions, we reject sequences with a minimum root height below 0.25 0.25 m, joint velocities exceeding the corresponding hardware limits, severe self-intersection, or excessive foot floating. Specifically, a frame is considered self-intersecting when the penetration depth exceeds 2 2 cm, and we reject sequences in which such frames account for more than 5% of the motion; we also require the mean lowest-foot height to remain below 0.10 0.10 m.
paragraphs.zh: 沿用以往人形重定向动作筛选工作（Lee et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026a）的思路，我们设计了一套规则来过滤源人类动作和重定向后的机器人动作。 对于人类动作，我们过滤掉根节点抖动过大或足部接触不足的序列。 对于机器人动作，我们剔除最低根节点高度低于0.25 0.25米、关节速度超过相应硬件极限、出现严重自碰撞或足部过度漂浮的序列。 具体而言，当穿透深度超过2 2厘米时，该帧被视为自碰撞帧；若此类帧占动作的比例超过5%，我们便剔除该序列；同时我们要求平均最低足部高度保持在0.10 0.10米以下。

paragraphs.en: For the test set, we additionally follow PHUMA ( Lee et al., 2026 ) and apply a base-of-support criterion to the human motion. We construct the support region as the convex hull of the horizontal projections of the left and right ankle and foot joints, and require the average horizontal distances of the pelvis and spine1 from this region to be below 6 6 cm and 11 11 cm, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 对于测试集，我们额外遵循 PHUMA（Lee et al., 2026），对人体运动施加支撑面判据。 我们将支撑区域构造为左右踝关节和足关节水平投影的凸包，并要求骨盆和 spine1 到该区域的平均水平距离分别低于 6 6 cm 和 11 11 cm。

paragraphs.zh: 对于仅包含局部无效片段的序列，我们将其拆分为较短的片段，并保留至少含有 100 帧的有效片段。 因此，我们改造后的 GMR 重定向器不一定会保持输入序列的长度，而是返回保留最多有效帧的候选结果。

paragraphs.en: Our humanoid reference motion generator takes human keypoints as input and does not rely on supervision from human body parameters. However, adapting the baseline methods to our training data requires a unified parametric representation of the human body. BONES-SEED represents human motion using SOMA ( Saito et al., 2026 ) , whereas all other datasets use SMPL-X ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) . We therefore convert the human motions in BONES-SEED to the SMPL-X representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的人形参考动作生成器以人体关键点作为输入，不依赖人体参数的监督。 然而，将基线方法适配到我们的训练数据需要统一的人体参数化表示。 BONES-SEED 使用 SOMA ( Saito et al., 2026 ) 表示人体动作，而其他所有数据集均使用 SMPL-X ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) 。 因此，我们将 BONES-SEED 中的人体动作转换为 SMPL-X 表示。

paragraphs.en: We first fit the SMPL-X shape parameters 𝜷 ∈ ℝ 10 \bm{\beta}\in\mathbb{R}^{10} for each actor. We reconstruct the actor-specific SOMA body mesh from its identity, scale, and bone-length parameters. Since the SOMA and SMPL-X models use different rest skeletons and mesh topologies, we re-pose the SOMA mesh using the rest-pose joint configuration of the corresponding SMPL-X model and then map the resulting mesh to the native SMPL-X topology. We then fit 𝜷 \bm{\beta} to the transferred vertices, using ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regularization on the shape parameters and Huber weighting to reduce the influence of large vertex errors. With the fitted 𝜷 \bm{\beta} fixed, we fit the remaining SMPL-X parameters using the official fitting script provided by SOMA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先为每个演员拟合 SMPL-X 形状参数 𝜷 ∈ ℝ 10 \bm{\beta}\in\mathbb{R}^{10}。 我们根据演员的身份、尺度和骨长参数重建其专属的 SOMA 身体网格。 由于 SOMA 与 SMPL-X 模型使用不同的静止骨架和网格拓扑，我们使用对应 SMPL-X 模型的静止姿态关节配置对 SOMA 网格进行重新摆姿，然后将所得网格映射到 SMPL-X 的原生拓扑上。 接着，我们将 𝜷 \bm{\beta} 拟合到迁移后的顶点上，对形状参数使用 ℓ 2 \ell_{2} 正则化，并采用 Huber 加权以降低大顶点误差的影响。 在拟合得到的 𝜷 \bm{\beta} 固定的情况下，我们使用 SOMA 提供的官方拟合脚本来拟合其余的 SMPL-X 参数。

paragraphs.en: We recruit 20 volunteer participants for the human study, all of whom have research backgrounds in computer vision or robotics, including 12 with prior experience in humanoid research. In each trial, participants are shown the original human demonstration video on top and two side-by-side humanoid motion results below. One result is produced by our method and the other by a baseline, with the left-right order randomized. Participants are asked to make a forced-choice judgment on which result better transfers the human motion depicted in the input video to the Unitree G1 humanoid.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为人类研究招募了20名志愿参与者，他们均具有计算机视觉或机器人领域的研究背景，其中12人曾有人形机器人研究经验。 在每次试验中，参与者会看到顶部为原始的人类演示视频，下方为两个并排的人形机器人运动结果。 其中一个结果由我们的方法生成，另一个由基线方法生成，左右顺序随机排列。 参与者被要求进行强制选择判断，选出哪一个结果能更好地将输入视频中展示的人类动作迁移到Unitree G1人形机器人上。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the executability of the generated humanoid reference motions, we adopt the standard metrics used in humanoid motion tracking evaluation. The definition of tracking success is provided in Section B.4 . For EMDB ( Kaufmann et al., 2023 ) and RICH ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , we evaluate tracking success independently on each 250-frame segment and report the average across segments, whereas no fixed segment-length constraint is imposed for the video-only test sets. All remaining metrics are computed on root-relative joint positions. mpjpe and pampjpe are computed between the tracked motion and the retargeted ground-truth motion, while Trk. mpjpe and Trk. pampjpe are computed between the reference motion and its tracked motion.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估生成的人形参考动作的可执行性，我们采用人形动作跟踪评估中使用的标准指标。 跟踪成功的定义见第 B.4 节。 对于 EMDB（Kaufmann et al., 2023）和 RICH（Huang et al., 2022），我们在每个 250 帧的片段上独立评估跟踪成功情况，并报告各片段的平均值；而对于仅视频测试集，则不施加固定的片段长度限制。 其余所有指标均在根部相对关节位置上计算。mpjpe 和 pampjpe 在跟踪动作与重定向后的真值动作之间计算，而 Trk. mpjpe 和 Trk. pampjpe 在参考动作与其跟踪动作之间计算。

paragraphs.en: Compared with the original GVHMR ( Shen et al., 2024 ) and GEM ( Li et al., 2025b ) , the adapted variants ( † \dagger ) differ in training data, model capacity, and visual encoder. paragraphs.en: Tables A2 and A3 repeat the comparisons of Tables 1 and 2 on EMDB and RICH with the ground-truth cameras provided by the datasets. The trends match those with estimated cameras. The offline generator outperforms all pipelines on every metric in both tables, and both post-trained generators achieve higher success rates and lower tracking errors than all pipelines. Post-training reduces self-penetration in every setting and jitter in most, lowers tracking errors, and raises or preserves success rates, while keeping local accuracy comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 表 A2 和表 A3 在 EMDB 和 RICH 数据集上使用数据集提供的真值相机，重复了表 1 和表 2 的比较。 其趋势与使用估计相机时的结果一致。 离线生成器在两张表的每个指标上都优于所有流水线，且两个经过后训练的生成器都比所有流水线取得了更高的成功率和更低的跟踪误差。 后训练在所有设置中减少了自穿透，在大多数设置中减少了抖动，降低了跟踪误差，并提高或保持了成功率，同时保持局部精度相当。

sents.zh: 表 A2 和表 A3 在 EMDB 和 RICH 数据集上使用数据集提供的真值相机，重复了表 1 和表 2 的比较。

sents.en: The trends match those with estimated cameras.
sents.zh: 其趋势与使用估计相机时的结果一致。

sents.en: The offline generator outperforms all pipelines on every metric in both tables, and both post-trained generators achieve higher success rates and lower tracking errors than all pipelines.
sents.zh: 离线生成器在两张表的每个指标上都优于所有流水线，且两个经过后训练的生成器都比所有流水线取得了更高的成功率和更低的跟踪误差。

sents.en: Post-training reduces self-penetration in every setting and jitter in most, lowers tracking errors, and raises or preserves success rates, while keeping local accuracy comparable.
sents.zh: 后训练在所有设置中减少了自穿透，在大多数设置中减少了抖动，降低了跟踪误差，并提高或保持了成功率，同时保持局部精度相当。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments demonstrate favorable scaling behavior across the model and data scales considered in this work, for both pre-training and post-training. However, the extent of our scaling study is limited by the available training data and computational resources, and we therefore do not explore substantially larger models or datasets beyond the regime studied here. Additionally, our current motion representation and tracking setup do not model dexterous hand poses. Consequently, the object-interaction behaviors considered in this work are primarily limited to whole-body manipulation of relatively large and simple objects, rather than fine-grained manipulation such as grasping small objects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验表明，在本工作所考虑的模型与数据规模范围内，无论是预训练还是后训练都展现出良好的扩展行为。 然而，我们的扩展研究的范围受限于可用的训练数据和计算资源，因此我们没有探索超出本文所研究范围的更大的模型或数据集。 此外，我们目前的运动表示和跟踪设置并未对灵巧手部姿态进行建模。 因此，本工作所考虑的物体交互行为主要局限于对相对较大且较简单的物体进行全身操作，而非诸如抓取小物体等细粒度操作。

sents.en: Our experiments demonstrate favorable scaling behavior across the model and data scales considered in this work, for both pre-training and post-training.

sents.en: Additionally, our current motion representation and tracking setup do not model dexterous hand poses.
sents.zh: 此外，我们目前的运动表示和跟踪设置并未对灵巧手部姿态进行建模。

sents.en: Consequently, the object-interaction behaviors considered in this work are primarily limited to whole-body manipulation of relatively large and simple objects, rather than fine-grained manipulation such as grasping small objects.
sents.zh: 因此，本工作所考虑的物体交互行为主要局限于对相对较大且较简单的物体进行全身操作，而非诸如抓取小物体等细粒度操作。

paragraphs.en: A natural next step is to further scale ViT-H with larger models, more diverse pre-training and post-training data, and increased computational resources. Beyond DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , it would also be interesting to explore alternative post-training algorithms, such as PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) or GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , for directly optimizing motion quality and executability. Moreover, while our experiments show that the improvements from motion-tracking feedback generalize across different trackers, future work could incorporate feedback from multiple trackers during post-training to provide a more robust executability signal. Finally, extending the motion representation and tracking framework to model hand poses would enable finer-grained object interactions, including grasping and manipulation of smaller objects.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的下一步是通过更大的模型、更多样的预训练与后训练数据以及更多的计算资源来进一步扩展 ViT-H。 除了 DPO（Rafailov et al., 2023）之外，探索其他后训练算法（如 PPO（Schulman et al., 2017）或 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024））来直接优化动作质量与可执行性，也将是十分有趣的。 此外，虽然我们的实验表明来自动作追踪反馈的改进可以在不同的追踪器之间泛化，但未来的工作可以在后训练期间纳入来自多个追踪器的反馈，以提供更稳健的可执行性信号。 最后，将动作表示与追踪框架扩展到对手部姿态进行建模，将实现更细粒度的物体交互，包括对更小物体的抓取与操控。
